description: This file appears to be a shell script used for managing GRE tunnels, network interfaces, and system events related to a hotspot device, including setting configurations, creating tunnels, and associated network setups.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes snooper system events for circuit and remote enabling.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from PSM database for GRE and hotspot settings.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates and configures GRE tunnels and related network interfaces.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events related to hotspot keep-alive settings.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for network traffic management.
